report.explanation: Current telemetry is internally inconsistent: gateway traces show an ERROR span to order at ~2s, yet gateway and order metrics/logs report low error rate, p95 72ms, and OK statuses. Order shows retained heap after GC with WARN logs, but a single snapshot cannot establish a leak. Deployment record proves only version facts. No bounded root cause is established; hand off for aligned error-rate/latency and chronological memory evidence.
missing_evidence: Gateway traces show one ERROR span to order (1991ms) but gateway metrics/logs show healthy error_rate 0.0014 and status 200; need aligned error-rate/latency series to confirm the alert.
Order traces show checkout OK at 1650ms; need order p95/error-rate time series to establish latency or error contribution.
Order memory_retained_bytes 340MB with retained_after_gc and 12 WARN retained_heap_after_gc logs; need chronological memory-retention series to assess a leak.
Need order heap/GC trend over time and baseline to distinguish a leak from steady-state retention.
Need downstream (inventory, payment, postgresql) latency/timeout evidence to rule out downstream-latency causes.
